title: Destiny's Twins
next_chapter_hook: The moment the blood resonance dissipated, a cold voice rang directly in Chen Ji's Mental Sea: 'Found you, child of destiny.' The oppressive force within that voice made Chen Ji certain—the Demonic Path commander had locked onto his location.

text.content: Above the ruined altar, the Tianji Record floated before Chen Ji's chest, its yellowed pages turning at a visible speed. With each page turned, a faint golden pattern overflowed, flowing into Chen Ji's Brow Center. Heavenly Fate Value was draining frantically, while the originally blurred images were reconstructing with unbelievable clarity.

Ye Qing's face turned ghastly pale. She stared intently at the blood-colored point on the seventh page of the Tianji Record that resonated with her from afar, her hands trembling involuntarily. 'This is impossible...' Her voice turned hoarse, as if she had witnessed the most terrifying thing in the world, 'The Twins of Destiny... the legend is actually true?'

Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, his expression terrifyingly serene. 'Miss Ye Qing,' his voice carried no warmth, 'now you have two choices. First, tell me everything you know about the Twins of Destiny. Second—' He paused briefly, a mocking curve forming at the corner of his lips, 'I will personally extract the answers from your Mental Sea, even if it leaves you a fool.'

Ye Qing abruptly lifted her head, a flash of shock and anger flickering in her eyes. She was a saint of the Demonic Path Holy Sect—when had she ever endured such threats? Yet when she met Chen Ji's unfathomably deep gaze, her retort died in her throat. In those eyes, there was no threat—only a cold statement of fact.

dialogue.content: 'The Twins of Destiny... were the two extremes formed when the Heavenly Will of ancient times divided,' Ye Qing's voice was hoarse. 'One inherits Heavenly Mandate, the other rebels against it. They are the Chess Players on the board, and they are the board itself. And I...' She gave a bitter smile, 'am merely one of the chosen vessels.'

text.content: At this moment, Chen Ji's Brow Center suddenly throbbed. Blood resonance exploded without warning, so intense it froze his entire body. A strange yet familiar power surged from the depths of the Tianji Record, like two intertwined serpents racing wildly through his meridians.

'Ugh!' Chen Ji groaned, falling to one knee. His left eye glowed with an eerie violet-gold light, while his right eye blazed with silver-white flames. In his Mental Sea, the seal on the fourth page of the Tianji Record became covered with countless cracks.

Meanwhile, in the Demonic Path army's command camp miles away, a figure shrouded in black mist slowly raised its head. It was a young and handsome face, yet its eyes held an age-inappropriate vicissitude and madness. 'Interesting...' he murmured, 'the other half of the Twins of Destiny is actually here.'

Li Qingming, the Demonic Path commander, slowly curled his lips upward. He raised his hand, and a drop of ink-black blood condensed at his fingertip. 'Since you voluntarily exposed your location, I'll gladly accept.' The blood drop shot out, merging into the formation beneath his feet. In the next instant, an invisible blood pulse wave swept across a thousand miles toward Chen Ji's location.

choice.prompt: The power of blood resonance was tearing at Chen Ji's consciousness. He had to make a choice:

choices.text: Suppress the resonance with the Tianji Record
choices.description: Forcefully activate the Tianji Record's sealing power to forcibly suppress the blood resonance. The cost is an additional 15 points of Heavenly Fate Value, and it may trigger the complete unsealing of the fourth page.
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily shield from the Demonic Path commander's perception
choices.risk_hint: The fourth page seal may become unstable

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly bit his tongue, spraying a mouthful of blood essence onto the floating Tianji Record. The fragment suddenly erupted with dazzling golden light, instantly suppressing the berserk blood resonance. However, the moment he exhaled in relief, the seal cracks on the fourth page of the Tianji Record suddenly expanded, and an old yet majestic voice emerged from within: 'The time... is not yet...'

choices.description: Stop resisting and instead actively guide this bloodline power, using this opportunity to see the truth of the Twins of Destiny. The risk is extremely high, but it may yield crucial intelligence.
choices.visible_reward: Glimpse a corner of the truth about the Twins of Destiny
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path commander may reverse-lock

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made a crazy decision. He released all resistance, letting the bloodline power rage through his body. In an instant, his consciousness was pulled into a chaotic Void. There, he saw two blurry figures playing chess, and on the board...赫然是天青宗的轮廓。

The moment Chen Ji made his choice, the blood pulse wave spanning a thousand miles finally reached the depths of the ruins. Ye Qing sensed the abnormality first, her face instantly draining of color: 'No good! He's using blood to locate you!'

Yet in the next instant, a cold, sinister voice resounded directly within Chen Ji's Mental Sea. That voice carried a condescending arrogance, as if examining prey that had fallen into a trap: 'Found you, Child of Fate.'

Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. The oppressive feeling in that voice reminded him of the terrifying aura he had once sensed within Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul. But what alarmed him even more were those four words—Child of Fate. The other party actually knew about the existence of the Tianji Record?

dialogue.content: 'Ye Qing.' Chen Ji's voice remained calm, yet his eyes had already ignited with cold killing intent. 'The Demon Path Commander Li Qingming—what is his position within the Holy Sect?' He didn't ask who the other party was, for the Tianji Record had long ago revealed that name to him. What he asked was the more crucial question—this person's trump card.

text.content: Ye Qing hesitated for a moment, but seeing the undeniable cold light in Chen Ji's eyes, she chose to answer truthfully: 'The number one among the Saint Sons. It's said he carries the bloodline of an ancient Demon Sovereign, naturally resonating with the Heavenly Dao's will.' Her voice grew lower. 'And... he is the only one permitted to make contact with the Eyes of Heavenly Dao.'

Eyes of Heavenly Dao. These four words struck Chen Ji like a basin of icy water. He had always believed the Eyes of Heavenly Dao to be merely a conceptual existence, a personification of the world's operating rules. But now it seemed they not only truly existed but also had their own representative.

choice.prompt: Facing the lock-on from the Demon Path Commander and the shadow of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao, Chen Ji needed to replan his layout:

choices.text: Turn the tables and set a counter-kill trap
choices.description: Since the enemy has already locked onto him, use this to advantage. Proactively expose more false information, lure the Demon Path Commander into the preset trap. Use myself as bait to catch the big fish.
choices.visible_reward: Might resolve the hidden danger of the Demon Path Commander in one fell swoop
choices.risk_hint: The Eyes of Heavenly Dao might personally intervene

text.content: 'Interesting.' Chen Ji let out a low laugh, that smile carrying a dangerous excitement. He had never feared powerful enemies, for he deeply understood one truth—the mightier an existence, the more devastating its fall. Since Li Qingming had come knocking, he wouldn't stand on ceremony.

choices.text: Temporarily evade the front, relocate the Tianji Record
choices.description: Now is not the time for direct confrontation with the Demon Path Commander. The secrets of the Tianji Record are too significant; they must first be moved to a safer location. Preserve the firewood for later.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the completeness of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Might be pursued all the way

text.content: Chen Ji had never been one to force a showdown. He deeply understood his situation—under the dual gaze of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao and the Demon Path Commander, any direct confrontation would be foolish. 'Go.' He decisively issued the command to Ye Qing. The secrets of the Tianji Record must not be exposed here.
Just as the two prepared to retreat, the space around the altar suddenly twisted violently. Jet-black spatial rifts appeared out of thin air, shrouding the entire ruins in an apocalyptic atmosphere.

dialogue.content: 'Too late.' A completely emotionless voice rang out from all directions simultaneously, that voice resembling both the cold laws of heaven's operation and the whisper of an ancient existence. 'Holder of the Tianji Record... no, should say candidate. You think yourself a Chess Player, yet you are unaware you have always been merely a piece on the chessboard.'

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils dilated sharply. The Eyes of Heavenly Dao—that existence he had always believed was merely conceptual—had actually manifested in person. He drew a deep breath, forcibly suppressing his surging emotions, and restored that harmless good-for-nothing expression on his face.

dialogue.content: 'Senior is jesting.' Chen Ji's voice was respectful and humble. 'This mere servant disciple merely stumbled upon a torn page by chance. How would I dare call myself a Chess Player?' His tone carried just the right amount of fear, yet his eyes rapidly scanned the surroundings, searching for any possible escape routes.

text.content: That voice seemed utterly uninterested in his performance, merely saying: 'The Twin Children of Fate have awakened. Li Qingming is one, and you...' it paused, 'are the other. No matter how you disguise yourself, the outcome will not change. Only one of you is fated to survive.'

These words struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer. He finally understood why the Tianji Record's visions were always shrouded in mist—because the other Twin Child of Fate, like a hidden mirror, had always been disrupting his foresight. Li Qingming... from the very beginning, they were destined mortal enemies.

choice.prompt: In the face of fate's pronouncement, Chen Ji displayed two截然不同的两面:

choices.text: A cold smile: 'Destined? Then I will rewrite this destiny.'
choices.description: Chen Ji reveals his true edge. The waste persona? No, that was just camouflage. He never serves as a slave to fate—he will rewrite this ending with his own hands.
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining the true attention of the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: Risk of being obliterated on the spot

text.content: 'Interesting.' That voice seemed to carry a hint of emotion for the first time, 'Countless years, and you're the first to dare say such words to me.' After a pause, its voice turned cold again, 'But this changes nothing. Fate has already been written. You're merely struggling in your death throes.'

choices.text: Lowering his head in silence: 'This junior understands.'
choices.description: Chen Ji puts on the waste mask once more, retreating to advance. A true hunter never rushes. He needs time to lay his plans, to await the opportunity for counterattack.
choices.visible_cost: Risk of being seen as weak
choices.visible_reward: Securing precious time for strategic positioning

text.content: 'Wise.' The Heavenly Eye's voice carried no approval or contempt. 'But remember, delay won't alter the outcome. A battle between the twins of destiny is inevitable, and I... will quietly observe this grand spectacle from beyond the chessboard.' With those words, the terrifying pressure gradually dissipated, and the warped space returned to normal.

The ruins fell silent once more, yet Chen Ji understood this tranquility was merely the calm before the tempest. Gazing down at the Tianji Record, the sealed cracks on the fourth page had widened, with something within subtly stirring, hinting at the secrets sealed within.

dialogue.content: 'Mo Xiansheng.' Chen Ji called out in his mind, 'What truly defines the twins of destiny? Why did the Tianji Record fail to provide advance warning?' He needed an answer—a clarity that could illuminate his path through this intricate game of fate.

text.content: After a contemplative silence, the aged voice resounded once more: 'Because... the twins of destiny are inherently a flaw within the Tianji Record.' Mo Xiansheng's tone carried an unusual hint of weariness, 'The creator who forged the Tianji Record likely never anticipated such a variable.' He paused, then added, 'Yet this also presents your opportunity. The twins of destiny... one yin and one yang, one righteous and one evil. Should you shatter this binary opposition, you might completely break free from the chessboard's constraints.'

Chen Ji raised his head, a contemplative light flickering in his eyes. Shattering the binary opposition... this meant he couldn't simply oppose Li Qingming, nor could he simply align with him. He needed to find that third path beyond both.

Ye Qing had been quietly observing the entire scene, her gaze intricate and her mind swirling with countless thoughts. Could this man truly be the notorious waste servant disciple of the Tianqing Sect? That composure before destiny, that defiant pride even against heavenly will—qualities no ordinary waste could possess.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji.' Ye Qing finally spoke, her voice carrying an unexpected softness, 'Regardless of who you are, I owe you an explanation. Regarding the twins of destiny, about myself... when you're ready, seek me at the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path.' A resolute light flickered in her eyes, 'I'm willing to become a piece on your chessboard.'

text.content: Chen Ji glanced at her, giving a slight nod. For once, his response wasn't tinged with sarcasm or calculation, but genuine sincerity: 'Keep your word.' A subtle smile played at the corner of his lips, 'Next we meet, I hope you've decided which side you'll stand on.' He turned toward the ruins' exit, his figure quickly vanishing into the darkness.

Ye Qing watched his retreating figure, an inexplicable complexity welling within her. His silhouette seemed both solitary and unwavering. A saying surfaced in her thoughts—truly formidable individuals are often the most isolated, traversing paths no one else can comprehend.

At the same moment, atop a secluded peak of the Tianqing Sect, an elderly figure with silver hair and beard slowly opened his eyes. Ling Yuan—ostensibly Chen Ji's protector—his gaze now glinting with profound significance. 'The twins of destiny, it seems...' he murmured, 'This game proves far more intricate than anticipated.' A cold, calculating smile curved his lips, 'Chen Ji, the more you struggle against fate, the more you'll require my intervention. Eventually...' he chuckled darkly...
